hypothetical_scenarios.name: Insured claims sensitivity
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: A small claims percentage can have a large contribution effect.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Other items excluded, same cohort and period.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Fixed fee versus product value
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: A product-price fall need not reduce fixed unit fees.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Pure fixed fee; constant volume and cost; not assigned to a real company.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Percentage fee counterexample
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: The same price change has different effects with percentage compensation.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Pure percentage fee; constant volume and cost; no real contract assumed.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Cash timing
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: Payment timing changes present value without changing nominal cash.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Illustrative rate only, not a recommended discount rate or company valuation.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Share denominator
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: EPS arithmetic alone cannot establish value creation.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Financing and opportunity costs excluded explicitly.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Unknown sharing terms
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Do not infer zero or 100% retention.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Annualized opportunity before launch
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: Annualized opportunity is not current booked revenue.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Artificial flat monthly illustration only; launch, price, ramp and claims unknown.

hypothetical_scenarios.name: Earnings and multiple change
hypothetical_scenarios.lesson: Higher earnings need not mechanically produce a higher valuation.
hypothetical_scenarios.assumptions: Illustrative positive-earnings identity, not actual multiples or a forecast.

research_opportunities.next_observation: Comparable cohort run-out and renewal terms.
research_opportunities.falsifier: Adverse development, mix-only improvement, retention loss or returned savings.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Prior period means prior year
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve service year 2026 for the majority of the disclosed development.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Sum integrated segments into market size
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Require consolidation/eliminations and economic pool identity.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: All operating cash improvement is recurring earnings
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Separate payment timing from sustainable unit profit.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Subtract ratios with different denominators
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Reconstruct common currency amounts first.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Six-month reserve amount is a Q2-only saving
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve first-half reporting scope.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Absence of prior provision is a new cash receipt
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Separate comparator, recognition and settlement.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Premium-tax pass-through is customer demand
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Separate equal tax revenue and expense.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: All gross medical savings are retained
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Require risk-sharing/corridor terms; return unknown if missing.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Quarterly EPS times four is guidance
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve seasonality and actual/guidance distinction.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Raised EPS guidance proves repaired underwriting
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Inspect operating and below-line components separately.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Blended ratio applies to all insurance products
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve product cohort and denominator.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: All consolidated cash is available to owners
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve restrictions, obligations and parent liquidity.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Drug spending helps every pharmacy-service segment
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Inspect contract and segment contribution separately.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Customer relationships count unique people
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve overlapping populations.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Technology label implies no medical risk
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Inspect administrative versus risk-bearing arrangements.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Annualized conditional launch is booked revenue
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Keep launch condition, time and run-rate scope.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Product populations can be summed to unique members
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Respect disclosed overlap and the unique-member methodology.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Care Margin denominator equals revenue
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Retain the issuer denominator and labeled alternative.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Practice collections equal consolidated revenue
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve non-owned practices and accounting perimeter.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Paid claims alone prove incurred medical costs
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Reconcile estimates, prior-period revisions and ending liability.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: All platform lives form the revenue denominator
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Use covered average time for the consolidated arrangement.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: A Q2 recognition is entirely Q2 service
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve earlier service dates and associated expenses.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Revenue minus one care-cost category is net profit
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Retain administration, depreciation and other relevant costs.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Every therapy can shift to home infusion
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Require specific clinical/workflow/access evidence.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Lower distribution margin percentage means lower profit dollars
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Reconcile product value, retained dollars and mix.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Acquired earnings are free organic growth
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve perimeter, acquisition price and financing.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Old segment/fiscal labels are comparable unchanged
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Use current definitions and comparable periods.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Non-GAAP means fully recurring
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Inspect explicitly included one-time items.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Located download proves acquired rows
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Maintain distinct locator/bytes/parse/join/production states.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: 2026 metadata means 2026 claims or outcomes
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve observation versus plan/publication years.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Public pricing page is a current patient episode bill
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve payer/site/service/lookback and missing components.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Future public backfill is guaranteed
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve permitted snapshots; no assumed historical retention.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Gross Part D spending is manufacturer net revenue
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Preserve excluded rebates and payer/population scope.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Preliminary quarterly history is final and immutable
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Version run-out revisions and finalization.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Hypothetical sensitivity is an observed company forecast
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Keep toy assumptions and unknown materiality explicit.

adversarial_specifications.invalid_inference: Higher EPS mechanically guarantees a higher stock price
adversarial_specifications.required_response: Separate earnings, financing, expectations and valuation assumptions.
